content:
From the FTLD10CE3C datasheet, modes are split by application/rate where the data-rate table or applications list ties values together. LOS assert is one optical row (min/max), so the same assert level applies to all modes. Reach 0.1 km (OM3) and 0.15 km (OM4) are separate table rows for the same Ethernet-style MMF use cases.
